question: Should dashboard workspace tabs get path-segment URLs as part of the modular-dashboard stack, and should that be folded into the Workspaces UI PR or kept as a follow-up roadmap item?
rationale: Current main does not yet have the dashboard workspace surface, and the route choice depends on the still-open dashboard product direction rather than a standalone bug fix.

options.title: Keep as roadmap follow-up
options.body: Leave this issue open until the dashboard workspace PR stack is accepted, then implement the final route shape against the landed code.

options.title: Fold into Workspaces UI PR
options.body: Ask the dashboard PR author to replace the proposed `?ws=` tab state with path segments before the Workspaces UI PR lands.

options.title: Defer with dashboard stack

recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until the dashboard workspace PR stack is accepted, then implement the final route shape against the landed code.
